section.44: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

44.name_native: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

hadiths.text: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Allah has granted pardon to the tribe of Ghifar and to the tribe of Aslam Allah has granted safety and as for Usayya tribe, they disobeyed Allah and His Messenger
